clock.titleFilmExcluded: the suite runs 1498.66s and the cut 1440.07s; the difference is the title film, which the cut does not carry
clock.knownHole: cineosis's containers hold one 402 ms hole between NEVERMORE and BLOODLINES; addressing from the container carries it, summing durations does not

stillNeeded.video, clip, thumb, strip: encode. The renderer already draws every frame; this is an ffmpeg pass per shot plus one thumb and one strip, and nothing has to be decided.
stillNeeded.xy, sim, affinity, aff_top: CLIP ViT-B-32 on the sampled frames, then a PROJECTION INTO cineosis's existing t-SNE and 45-way affinity. Fitting a new map instead puts these shots in a space sharing no axes with the other 15,149 and every neighbour it reports is false.
stillNeeded.signs: a person. cineosis has them for 253 of 15,149 shots. These 80 come with their own line and label, which is a better starting point than a thumbnail, but the sign is still a reading.
